Description: Welcome to resort-style living in the prestigious 55+ community of Valencia Trails. The sellers intended this to be their “forever home” and enhanced this Nautilus floor plan with gorgeous aftermarket upgrades. Set on a beautiful preserve lot, the home features a large screened lanai and fenced yard—perfect for enjoying the relaxing Florida lifestyle. Inside, the 13-foot coffered ceiling and custom lighting make a grand first impression in the entry foyer, while soaring 10-foot ceilings continue throughout the home. Lighted tray ceilings highlight both the great room and primary bedroom, and tile flooring runs throughout—NO CARPET! The spacious kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, with a huge quartz island, abundant cabinetry, GE  appliances, gas cooktop, and pot filler. Custom wood detailing enhances the island and primary bedroom, while the great room features a lighted wall with shelving and a beautiful fireplace. The den includes custom cabinetry and shelving. Additional upgrades include designer light fixtures and fans, abundant recessed lighting, plantation shutters on all windows, and custom closets. The garage features epoxy flooring, ceiling-mounted lift storage racks, and a separate GOLF-CART STALL with its own garage door. Impact glass windows and doors, a tile roof, X flood zone, and whole-house Generac generator add to the home's extensive list of features and provide additional peace of mind. Located in a quiet pocket on the south side of Valencia Trails, this home is conveniently positioned near the new Vanderbilt Beach Road entrance for easy access in and out of the community. Valencia Trails residents enjoy a 43,000-square-foot clubhouse and 10 acres of recreation, including a resort-style pool and spa, lap and resistance pools, state-of-the-art fitness center, full-service spa, pickleball, tennis, and bocce. Additional amenities include an indoor restaurant with outdoor patio dining, social hall, cooking studio, arts and crafts facilities, numerous clubs, activities, and a very active social calendar!

Description: Welcome to 10102 Palazzo Dr, a beautifully customized residence in the exclusive gated community of Palazzo at Naples. Custom built and thoughtfully expanded beyond the standard Serino model, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2,522 square feet of upgraded living space, with all four corners extended an additional four feet and a rare extended 3-car garage. This home allows for an effortless transition—simply bring your personal belongings and begin enjoying the Naples lifestyle immediately. From the moment you enter through the doors, the craftsmanship is evident. Custom wood ceiling beams, designer lighting, coffered ceilings, and crown molding create architectural depth and character throughout. The great room is anchored by a built-in feature wall with electric fireplace, offering both warmth and refined style ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The chef’s kitchen blends elegance and performance with double-thick granite countertops, an oversized island, gas cooktop, built-in wall oven and microwave, wine refrigerator, custom cabinetry, and designer backsplash. Natural gas service adds convenience and long-term value. The primary suite serves as a private retreat with his and hers walk-in closets, tray ceilings, and a spa-inspired bathroom featuring a freestanding soaking tub, upgraded shower, dual vanities, and curated finishes. Outdoors, enjoy your own resort-style setting. The hot tub and heated pool with waterfall and sun shelf are complemented by a custom outdoor kitchen with Alfresco grill, a spacious covered lanai, and lush privacy landscaping, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. Additional highlights include impact-resistant windows and doors, Sonos whole-home audio, central vacuum, generator transfer switch, and approximately $30,000 in custom garage cabinetry. Palazzo at Naples is an intimate gated enclave with low quarterly HOA fees and a prime North Naples location minutes from I-75, Mercato, Waterside Shops, top-rated dining, and optional golf and pickleball memberships at nearby Quail Creek and Longshore Lake. A rare opportunity to own a thoughtfully upgraded, move-in-ready home in one of North Naples’ most desirable boutique communities.

Description:
Welcome to 18682 Spruce Dr E, a beautifully remodeled pool home situated on a rare triple lot in Fort Myers, offering modern finishes, extensive upgrades, and plenty of outdoor space. Thoughtfully renovated throughout, this move-in-ready home combines contemporary style with the desirable Florida lifestyle.

The completely updated kitchen features brand-new soft-close cabinetry, beautiful quartz countertops, and new appliances, with a one-year manufacturer’s warranty included on the appliances. A stylish new wet bar adds the perfect space for entertaining family and friends.

Throughout the home, you’ll find new luxury vinyl plank flooring, recessed lighting, updated light fixtures, and new ceiling fans. The bathrooms have been fully renovated with modern vanities, beautifully tiled showers, and sleek glass shower doors.

Step outside and enjoy your private pool, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying the Florida sunshine. The property sits on a triple lot, providing an abundance of outdoor space and added flexibility that is increasingly hard to find.

Additional improvements include a brand-new hurricane-impact garage door and a freshly finished epoxy garage floor, combining durability with a clean, modern appearance.

The roof was replaced in 2023, providing added peace of mind, while the interior and exterior have been freshly painted for a clean and contemporary look.

With its extensive renovations, private pool, rare triple-lot setting, and desirable Fort Myers location, this home offers the perfect combination of modern comfort and Florida living. Move-in ready and waiting for its next owner!

Description:

Description:
This beautiful 3 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | 12-ft Ceilings home in Audubon Country Club offers traditional elegance, abundant natural light, and exceptional privacy on an oversized cul-de-sac homesite. Volume ceilings and oversized windows create bright, welcoming interiors, while a wood-burning fireplace provides a timeless focal point between the Living and Dining Rooms. Adjacent to the Dining Room, the spacious Family Room and Kitchen offer generous gathering space ideal for everyday living and entertaining.  The home underwent an extensive renovation in 2017, including high-quality kitchen cabinetry with abundant storage, upgraded appliances, and beautiful countertops.  All bathrooms were fully remodeled to reflect today’s design trends, and the entire home was re-piped (2017) during the renovation. The roof is approximately six years old. A thoughtful floorplan expansion provides additional square footage (covered lanai enclosed & additional bathroom from garage sq footage) compared to similar models. Impact French doors lead from the main living areas to the outdoor retreat.  The screened Lanai offers exceptional outdoor living with abundance of open-air space, a private Pool and Spa, white travertine pavers, and a retractable decorative awning. The oversized homesite provides peaceful nature views and a high level of privacy, creating a serene setting for relaxation or entertaining.
Devon Green residents enjoy enhanced HOA services including front-yard landscaping and exterior painting, offering a low-maintenance lifestyle with a beautifully maintained streetscape.
Audubon Country Club is a premier gated community west of US-41, known for its vibrant social atmosphere, golf, tennis, pickleball, dining, and nature preserves. Ideally located just minutes from Naples’ beaches, shopping, dining, and cultural attractions, Audubon offers an unmatched blend of luxury and convenience. Social or Golf membership is required.

Spend your mornings overlooking the lake, enjoy an afternoon round of golf, relax by the community pool, or gather with friends at the clubhouse. Valencia combines the atmosphere and amenities of a Naples golf community with a relaxed, approachable lifestyle. Seller Financing may be available.

Description: Nestled within a low-density, highly desirable community, this spacious 2-bedroom plus den, 2-bath condo offers 2160 square feet of living space with a den and bonus room—ideal for flexible living. Enjoy peaceful, unobstructed views of the surrounding preserve, where wildlife is a daily sight right from your own lanai. Key features - Spacious Open Concept, a seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Step outside onto your expansive lanai and unwind as you take in the tranquil preserve views—an ideal space for dining, relaxing, or entertaining. Surrounded by nature, you'll enjoy daily sightings of wildlife, creating a peaceful, serene atmosphere. The Kitchen offers ample storage space with pull out drawers, a walk-in pantry and center island. The versatile den makes a great office, separate living area or overflow bedroom while the bonus room provides additional flexibility. The master suite with a walk-in closet and an en-suite bathroom features dual vanities, brand new shower, and separate water closet. The guest bedroom with an en-suite bath is great for guest and family offering privacy. Also a new HVAC system and washer & dryer. Located just minutes from shopping, dining, and major highways, this home offers the best of both worlds—tranquility and convenience. This community offers a pool & friendly community center or join the private club. Membership to Kensington is optional offering social, sports or golf. So much to do w/tennis / pickleball / bocce courts, restaurants, pool and non stop events. So close to restaurants, the beach and all Naples has to offer. Pet friendly!
